player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔn wɛ Player {player_id} le SimpleTak mẹ.
Le tablo ɖo, a nukɔntɔ si wɛ '{player_stone}' bɔ a ɖɔkɔntɔ si wɛ '{opponent_stone}'.

Le a zɔn, dɔ a ɖo si kuɖo (le e nɔmɛ si) bɔ sɔ a nukɔntɔ ɖo.
Apɛ, '[12]' sɔ a nukɔntɔ ɖo le kuɖo 12.

A ɖo ɖi wɛ na a nukɔntɔ si tɔn ɖo si kuɖo ɖo le tablo ɖo (kpevi-kpevi alo kpevi-kɔnɛ).

invalid_move.invalid_move_format: Wema e è na lɛ́ yí ɔ nyí nǔtí ǎ
invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nᴐkɔ́nɛ́ kɛkɛ {cell_num} ɖɔ̀ wɛ. Ɖo ɖi 0 kɔ́sɛ {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Hweɖoxó {cell_num} ɔ́ ɖò mɛ̀. Sɔ́ nùɖé ɖó xɔ ɖé mɛ ǎ.

action.placement: Abla {current_player_id} xɔ ŋkɔ́nɛ́ ({symbol}) ɖo to ŋkɔ́nɛ́ {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Player {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') kuɖo ɖo si tɔn ɖo!
outcome.draw: Akpá ɔ́ bǐ kpé. É nyí nǔ ɖokpo!
